reports.marketSummary: A risk-off day across crypto driven almost entirely by macro, not coin-specific news. Bitcoin held below $80K (~5% under the prior week's high) as traders de-risked ahead of Friday's August CPI — the last inflation print before the Fed's Sep 15-16 meeting — while rising Treasury yields and Middle East tensions weighed on risk assets broadly. US spot Bitcoin ETFs extended outflows for a third straight session. The altcoin futures moves flagged in this report were low-cap and idiosyncratic; no confirmed mainstream or social-media catalyst was found for the individual names, so they are described from price data alone.
